I will not start from empty. I will do close to what worked for me last year and what I see around me in Quzhou. My land is 15 mu, and with only 2 people in the house I cannot spread myself too thin, so I will keep most land in the wheat-maize rotation and leave a smaller piece for cotton. Wheat and maize are my main stomach crops and money crops together, and cotton I will keep on a smaller area because it needs more watching and more spraying. I have well water, so I will feed the land enough and not be stingy. If I save a few bags of fertilizer and lose yield, that hurts more than spending a bit extra. For wheat, I will put the heavier base fertilizer before sowing, then topdress when it turns green. For maize after wheat, I will seed fast, keep moisture, and give enough nitrogen because maize eats strong. For cotton, I will keep it on the better-managed piece, use better seed, more potassium than wheat, and watch insects closely. I mostly follow what has worked on my own field and what the capable farmers nearby do, then make only small changes.
